name: EM Carry-to-Vol Rank: BRL/MXN/ZAR/TRY/COP Next-Month Returns
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, COP by carry-to-vol each month (carry = local 3M interbank rate minus USD Fed Funds; vol = 21-day realized vol). TRY carry-to-vol is winsorized at the 95th percentile (252-day rolling) before ranking to prevent permanent Rank 5 dominance. Rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol, Rank 5 = highest. Pools all 5 currencies' monthly rank and next-month EM/USD return observations into rank-bucket series, then aggregates. Shows: (1) bar chart of avg next-month EM/USD return by rank 1-5, (2) summary table with N/median/hit rate/mean per rank, (3) carry-to-vol over time for all 5 currencies. Last 10 years (2016-2026).
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANK: DO HIGH-CARRY EM CURRENCIES OUTPERFORM NEXT MONTH?
# =============================================================================
# Universe: BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, COP (all quoted as USDXXX)
# Carry = local 3M interbank rate minus USD Fed Funds (annualized %)
# Vol   = 21-day realized annualized vol of daily FX returns
# Carry-to-Vol = carry / vol (Sharpe-like ratio for carry)
# TRY winsorized at 95th pct (252-day rolling) before ranking
# Rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol, Rank 5 = highest
# FX convention: inverted so positive return = EM currency appreciated vs USD
# Pooled approach: all 5 currencies' monthly (rank, fwd_ret) observations
#   are stacked into rank-bucket series and aggregated
# =============================================================================

bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# FX DATA — USDXXX pairs (all quoted as USD per EM unit)
# Invert: positive return = EM currency appreciated vs USD
# =============================================================================

fx_brl_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
fx_mxn_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDMXN')()
fx_zar_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDZAR')()
fx_try_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDTRY')()
fx_cop_raw = fx_pairs(ticker='USDCOP')()

# Daily close (USDXXX)
close_brl = ffill(fx_brl_raw.c)
close_mxn = ffill(fx_mxn_raw.c)
close_zar = ffill(fx_zar_raw.c)
close_try = ffill(fx_try_raw.c)
close_cop = ffill(fx_cop_raw.c)

# =============================================================================
# INTEREST RATES — local 3M interbank (monthly FRED, ffilled to daily)
# =============================================================================

# Brazil: immediate call money/interbank rate (monthly, ends Jan 2026)
rate_brl_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
rate_brl = ffill(rate_brl_raw.result)

# Mexico: 3M interbank rate (monthly, ends Jan 2026)
rate_mxn_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
rate_mxn = ffill(rate_mxn_raw.result)

# South Africa: 3M interbank rate (monthly, ends Jan 2026)
rate_zar_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
rate_zar = ffill(rate_zar_raw.result)

# Turkey: call money/interbank rate (monthly, ends Dec 2025)
rate_try_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01TRM156N')()
rate_try = ffill(rate_try_raw.result)

# Colombia: 3M interbank rate (monthly, ends Jan 2026)
rate_cop_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='COLIR3TIB01STM')()
rate_cop = ffill(rate_cop_raw.result)

# USD: Fed Funds effective rate (daily, ends Mar 2026)
rate_usd_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()
rate_usd = ffill(rate_usd_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY = local rate - USD Fed Funds (annualized %, daily)
# =============================================================================

carry_brl = rate_brl - rate_usd
carry_mxn = rate_mxn - rate_usd
carry_zar = rate_zar - rate_usd
carry_try = rate_try - rate_usd
carry_cop = rate_cop - rate_usd

# =============================================================================
# REALIZED VOL = 21-day annualized vol of daily log returns (decimal fraction)
# =============================================================================

vol_brl = volatility(period=21)(close_brl)
vol_mxn = volatility(period=21)(close_mxn)
vol_zar = volatility(period=21)(close_zar)
vol_try = volatility(period=21)(close_try)
vol_cop = volatility(period=21)(close_cop)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL (daily)
# vol is in decimal fraction (e.g. 0.10 = 10% annualized)
# carry is in % (e.g. 5.0 = 5%). Divide carry by 100 to match vol scale,
# then compute ratio. Guard against near-zero vol.
# =============================================================================

ctv_brl = where(is_valid(vol_brl) and vol_brl > 0.001, (carry_brl / 100.0) / vol_brl)
ctv_mxn = where(is_valid(vol_mxn) and vol_mxn > 0.001, (carry_mxn / 100.0) / vol_mxn)
ctv_zar = where(is_valid(vol_zar) and vol_zar > 0.001, (carry_zar / 100.0) / vol_zar)
ctv_try_raw_val = where(is_valid(vol_try) and vol_try > 0.001, (carry_try / 100.0) / vol_try)
ctv_cop = where(is_valid(vol_cop) and vol_cop > 0.001, (carry_cop / 100.0) / vol_cop)

# =============================================================================
# WINSORIZE TRY carry-to-vol at 95th percentile (252-day rolling)
# Prevents TRY from permanently dominating Rank 5 during extreme rate episodes
# =============================================================================

ctv_try = winsorize(lower_limit=0.05, upper_limit=0.95)(ctv_try_raw_val)

# =============================================================================
# DOWNSAMPLE TO MONTHLY (last value of each month)
# =============================================================================

ctv_brl_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_brl)
ctv_mxn_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_mxn)
ctv_zar_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_zar)
ctv_try_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_try)
ctv_cop_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_cop)

# Monthly FX close (USDXXX)
close_brl_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close_brl)
close_mxn_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close_mxn)
close_zar_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close_zar)
close_try_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close_try)
close_cop_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close_cop)

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK (monthly, ascending: rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol)
# cs_rank runs across all assets — but here we have assets=[], so we rank
# each currency's monthly ctv against the others using a manual approach:
# rank each currency by comparing to the other 4 at each monthly bar.
# =============================================================================

# Manual rank: count how many of the 5 currencies have ctv <= this currency's ctv
# rank = 1 + number of others strictly below this currency
# Ties broken by order (BRL < MXN < ZAR < TRY < COP)

# (placeholder removed — actual ranks computed below)

# =============================================================================
# NEXT-MONTH EM/USD RETURN (inverted: positive = EM appreciated vs USD)
# forward_returns(period=1) on monthly close = next-month return of USDXXX
# Invert: EM/USD return = -1 * USDXXX return
# =============================================================================

fwd_usdxxx_brl = forward_returns(period=1)(close_brl_m)
fwd_usdxxx_mxn = forward_returns(period=1)(close_mxn_m)
fwd_usdxxx_zar = forward_returns(period=1)(close_zar_m)
fwd_usdxxx_try = forward_returns(period=1)(close_try_m)
fwd_usdxxx_cop = forward_returns(period=1)(close_cop_m)

# Invert: positive = EM currency appreciated vs USD
fwd_brl = -1.0 * fwd_usdxxx_brl
fwd_mxn = -1.0 * fwd_usdxxx_mxn
fwd_zar = -1.0 * fwd_usdxxx_zar
fwd_try = -1.0 * fwd_usdxxx_try
fwd_cop = -1.0 * fwd_usdxxx_cop

# =============================================================================
# RANK EACH CURRENCY MONTHLY (manual ordinal rank across 5 currencies)
# At each monthly bar, sort the 5 ctv values and assign ranks 1-5.
# We compute rank for each currency as: 1 + count of others strictly less than it.
# Ties: lower-indexed currency gets lower rank (BRL < MXN < ZAR < TRY < COP).
# =============================================================================

# All 5 valid guard
all_valid_m = is_valid(ctv_brl_m) and is_valid(ctv_mxn_m) and is_valid(ctv_zar_m) and is_valid(ctv_try_m) and is_valid(ctv_cop_m)

# BRL rank: 1 + count of currencies strictly less than BRL
rank_brl = where(all_valid_m, 1.0 + (1.0 if ctv_mxn_m < ctv_brl_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_zar_m < ctv_brl_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_try_m < ctv_brl_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_cop_m < ctv_brl_m else 0.0))

# MXN rank: 1 + count of currencies strictly less than MXN
rank_mxn = where(all_valid_m, 1.0 + (1.0 if ctv_brl_m < ctv_mxn_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_zar_m < ctv_mxn_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_try_m < ctv_mxn_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_cop_m < ctv_mxn_m else 0.0))

# ZAR rank
rank_zar = where(all_valid_m, 1.0 + (1.0 if ctv_brl_m < ctv_zar_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_mxn_m < ctv_zar_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_try_m < ctv_zar_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_cop_m < ctv_zar_m else 0.0))

# TRY rank
rank_try = where(all_valid_m, 1.0 + (1.0 if ctv_brl_m < ctv_try_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_mxn_m < ctv_try_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_zar_m < ctv_try_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_cop_m < ctv_try_m else 0.0))

# COP rank
rank_cop = where(all_valid_m, 1.0 + (1.0 if ctv_brl_m < ctv_cop_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_mxn_m < ctv_cop_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_zar_m < ctv_cop_m else 0.0) + (1.0 if ctv_try_m < ctv_cop_m else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# POOLED RANK-BUCKET SERIES
# For each rank 1-5, collect all (currency, month) observations where that
# currency had that rank, and record the next-month EM/USD return.
# This pools all 5 currencies' observations into a single rank-bucket series.
# =============================================================================

# Rank 1 bucket (lowest carry-to-vol) — coalesce all 5 currencies in one expression
pool_r1 = coalesce(where(is_valid(rank_brl) and rank_brl == 1.0, fwd_brl), where(is_valid(rank_mxn) and rank_mxn == 1.0, fwd_mxn), where(is_valid(rank_zar) and rank_zar == 1.0, fwd_zar), where(is_valid(rank_try) and rank_try == 1.0, fwd_try), where(is_valid(rank_cop) and rank_cop == 1.0, fwd_cop))

# Rank 2 bucket
pool_r2 = coalesce(where(is_valid(rank_brl) and rank_brl == 2.0, fwd_brl), where(is_valid(rank_mxn) and rank_mxn == 2.0, fwd_mxn), where(is_valid(rank_zar) and rank_zar == 2.0, fwd_zar), where(is_valid(rank_try) and rank_try == 2.0, fwd_try), where(is_valid(rank_cop) and rank_cop == 2.0, fwd_cop))

# Rank 3 bucket
pool_r3 = coalesce(where(is_valid(rank_brl) and rank_brl == 3.0, fwd_brl), where(is_valid(rank_mxn) and rank_mxn == 3.0, fwd_mxn), where(is_valid(rank_zar) and rank_zar == 3.0, fwd_zar), where(is_valid(rank_try) and rank_try == 3.0, fwd_try), where(is_valid(rank_cop) and rank_cop == 3.0, fwd_cop))

# Rank 4 bucket
pool_r4 = coalesce(where(is_valid(rank_brl) and rank_brl == 4.0, fwd_brl), where(is_valid(rank_mxn) and rank_mxn == 4.0, fwd_mxn), where(is_valid(rank_zar) and rank_zar == 4.0, fwd_zar), where(is_valid(rank_try) and rank_try == 4.0, fwd_try), where(is_valid(rank_cop) and rank_cop == 4.0, fwd_cop))

# Rank 5 bucket (highest carry-to-vol)
pool_r5 = coalesce(where(is_valid(rank_brl) and rank_brl == 5.0, fwd_brl), where(is_valid(rank_mxn) and rank_mxn == 5.0, fwd_mxn), where(is_valid(rank_zar) and rank_zar == 5.0, fwd_zar), where(is_valid(rank_try) and rank_try == 5.0, fwd_try), where(is_valid(rank_cop) and rank_cop == 5.0, fwd_cop))

# =============================================================================
# HIT RATE: fraction of months where EM currency appreciated (fwd_ret > 0)
# Use ternary (not where) so 0.0 is counted, not dropped
# =============================================================================

hit_r1 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r1) and pool_r1 > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(pool_r1) else pool_r1)
hit_r2 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r2) and pool_r2 > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(pool_r2) else pool_r2)
hit_r3 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r3) and pool_r3 > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(pool_r3) else pool_r3)
hit_r4 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r4) and pool_r4 > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(pool_r4) else pool_r4)
hit_r5 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r5) and pool_r5 > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(pool_r5) else pool_r5)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Avg next-month EM/USD return by carry-to-vol rank (1=lowest, 5=highest)
# Pooled across all 5 currencies and all months in the 10-year window
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Does Higher Carry-to-Vol Rank Predict Better EM Returns?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Rank (1=Lowest, 5=Highest)',
    y_axis_label='Avg Next-Month EM/USD Return',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 2'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 3'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 4'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 5')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(values=(pool_r1, pool_r2, pool_r3, pool_r4, pool_r5))

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Carry-to-Vol over time for all 5 currencies (monthly)
# =============================================================================

bar_idx_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(bar_idx)

xy_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol by Currency (Monthly, TRY Winsorized at 95th Pct)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BRL', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MXN', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZAR', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TRY', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='COP', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_idx_m, y_values=(ctv_brl_m, ctv_mxn_m, ctv_zar_m, ctv_try_m, ctv_cop_m))

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: N / Median / Hit Rate / Mean per rank bucket
# summary_table in RowSpec GROUP BY mode:
#   rows = [N, Median, Hit Rate, Mean]
#   col_headers = ['Rank 1', 'Rank 2', 'Rank 3', 'Rank 4', 'Rank 5']
#   inputs: (pool_r1, rank_label_1) ... but RowSpec mode needs 2 inputs
# Use standard mode with explicit cells instead (5 ranks x 4 stats = 20 cells)
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Next-Month EM/USD Return by Carry-to-Vol Rank (Pooled, 10Y)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['N (months)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% positive)', 'Mean Return'],
        col_headers=['Rank 1', 'Rank 2', 'Rank 3', 'Rank 4', 'Rank 5'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: N
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Median return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Hit rate (mean of 0/1 indicator = fraction positive)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Mean return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    order=2
)(pool_r1, pool_r2, pool_r3, pool_r4, pool_r5, pool_r1, pool_r2, pool_r3, pool_r4, pool_r5, hit_r1, hit_r2, hit_r3, hit_r4, hit_r5, pool_r1, pool_r2, pool_r3, pool_r4, pool_r5)
